propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all findings unconditionally, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks whose remedy is a ticket-side plan attestation, not a code change

when a ticket earns a plan-review attestation after an initial bugfix-size-attestation block, the block remains locked even on no-code-change patchsets because the copy condition does not re-evaluate findings tied to ticket state

bugfix-size-attestation finding blocks should be re-reviewable once the named ticket carries a current, accepted plan-review attestation, as determined by the gate's own classifier and bucketing logic

recheck-review acceptance for bugfix-size-attestation must be gated on strict preconditions: exactly one blocking finding with that criterion id, attestation resolving from the commit-message ticket id (not the finding text), and the attestation bucketing as accepted (not absent, stale-material, mismatch, invalid, or infra-error)
all parse and precondition failures must refuse fail-closed, with the observed verdict named in the refusal reply
